testcase.name: InboxPage > shows a message when no mailbox is available yet
InboxPage > shows a loading indicator while messages are being fetched
InboxPage > shows an empty-state message when the folder has no messages
InboxPage > shows an error message when loading messages fails
InboxPage > shows a generic error message when loading messages fails with a non-API error
InboxPage > lists messages and shows the detail pane with no message selected
InboxPage > falls back to the raw address and '(no subject)' in the message list row
InboxPage > on desktop > selects a message in place, marks it read, and passes it to the detail pane
InboxPage > on desktop > leaves other messages in the list untouched when marking one of several read
InboxPage > on desktop > does not re-mark an already-read message as read
InboxPage > on desktop > swallows a failed mark-as-read update rather than blocking selection
InboxPage > on mobile > navigates to the message detail route instead of selecting in place
NotFoundPage > renders a not-found message
ErrorPage > renders an internal-server-error message
Layout > renders the document shell with the given children inside the body
DevAutoAuthStrategy Tests > has the name 'jwt' so it can replace the real JWTStrategy in AuthMiddleware.
DevAutoAuthStrategy Tests > authenticate() > mints a fresh token and sets it as the jwt cookie when no cookie is present.
testcase.system-out: [DevAutoAuthStrategy.emit] 2026-09-08T07:14:02.626Z [33mwarn[39m: [DevAutoAuthStrategy] No valid session for /test — auto-authenticated as 'dev-user' (roles: admin). yarn dev only; never active in production.

testcase.name: DevAutoAuthStrategy Tests > authenticate() > honors an already-valid jwt cookie without minting or setting a new one.

DevAutoAuthStrategy Tests > authenticate() > re-mints a fresh token when an existing cookie decodes to this strategy's own dev uid but is missing a valid 'elevated' timestamp (a stale pre-elevation-fix token).
testcase.system-out: [DevAutoAuthStrategy.emit] 2026-09-08T07:14:02.630Z [33mwarn[39m: [DevAutoAuthStrategy] No valid session for /test — auto-authenticated as 'dev-user' (roles: admin). yarn dev only; never active in production.

testcase.name: DevAutoAuthStrategy Tests > authenticate() > re-mints a fresh token when an existing cookie decodes to this strategy's own dev uid with a non-positive 'elevated' value.
testcase.system-out: [DevAutoAuthStrategy.emit] 2026-09-08T07:14:02.631Z [33mwarn[39m: [DevAutoAuthStrategy] No valid session for /test — auto-authenticated as 'dev-user' (roles: admin). yarn dev only; never active in production.

testcase.name: DevAutoAuthStrategy Tests > authenticate() > honors a real (non-dev-uid) caller's unprivileged token as-is, even with no/negative 'elevated' — that's a normal, legitimate state for a real unprivileged user, not staleness.
DevAutoAuthStrategy Tests > authenticate() > falls back to minting a fresh token when the existing cookie fails to verify.
testcase.system-out: [DevAutoAuthStrategy.emit] 2026-09-08T07:14:02.632Z [33mwarn[39m: [DevAutoAuthStrategy] No valid session for /test — auto-authenticated as 'dev-user' (roles: admin). yarn dev only; never active in production.

testcase.name: DevAutoAuthStrategy Tests > authenticate() > still mints successfully when no response object is given (never throws on a missing res).
